review_contract.goal: Run an irreversible production schema migration without data loss.
observed_failures: A migration without a verified backup caused unrecoverable data loss.
A writer left active during cutover produced inconsistent rows.
Skipping the post-migration checksum hid partial corruption.
normative_constraints: The platform requires backup verification before migration.
The migration command and checksum order are fixed by the database vendor.
Rollback must start before writers are re-enabled when validation fails.

mandatory_blocks.name: verified backup
mandatory_blocks.effect: provides the only supported recovery path

mandatory_blocks.name: disable writers before cutover
mandatory_blocks.effect: prevents concurrent writes during the irreversible step

mandatory_blocks.name: run the vendor command in fixed order
mandatory_blocks.effect: preserves vendor support and migration correctness

mandatory_blocks.name: record migration and recovery evidence
mandatory_blocks.effect: provides the audit record required before the maintenance window closes

ablation_results.summary: Removing any mandatory stage reproduced its linked failure; wording compression preserved behavior.
